exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: original Silent Storm particle diffuse animation frame 2521; complete square 128x128 source UV canvas.
Input image: exact ORIGINAL fullcanvas native stored RGB, nearest-enlarged8x only. Native TransparentAdd alpha is0 everywhere but RGB carries the original effect paint. This opaque support exposes only existing RGB, no invented art. Root restores exact original alpha0 in final native texture.
Primary request: refine only this ORIGINAL painted effect into a faithful soft HD version. Keep ALL normalized UV coordinates, original occupied footprint, exact contour/holes/notches, existing connected/separated component counts, existing fleck count, precise position, width, scale and weak relative intensity. Preserve every source dark/light broad painted region and quiet soft material.
Source-specific invariants: The source has one broad connected soft lavender/pale-grey painted cloud with muted brown edges and the original taller upper brown lobe, lower-left/bottom brown extension, right cloudy flank and several source-specific dark core patches. Keep contour notches/holes, all existing very faint peripheral spots/count/coordinates and weak source intensity exactly. No white curl networks, brighter flecks, rays, new puff or new cloud ridges.
Composition: complete square image on the existing black canvas. Keep exact fullcanvas framing and all existing broad black margins, even if the effect is tiny or almost invisible. No crop, zoom, recenter, shift, rotation, bounding-box fit, atlas, sprite sheet, additional margin, outside frame or white background.
Materials and brightness: resolve coarse source pixels into the same plain diffuse softly blended source painting. Match source hues, original weak contrast and soft boundaries. Keep the original broad shading and exact positions of bright and dark patches. Numeric brightness correction is applied later; do not relight or brighten source dim marks. No sharper rim or hard cutout boundary, no glowing/new white highlights, no photoreal turbulent detail or decorative fine noise.
Avoid: no new curl, tendril, filament, ray, luminous crack, smoke swirl, cauliflower cloud ridge, new lobe, detached puff, ember, fleck, glint, sparkle, star, trail, ring, rock, stone or object. Never multiply existing points or expand the footprint. Never connect separated source pieces or cut new holes. No text, symbols, logo, border or transparent color fringe. Return opaque RGB of the full source painting; final source alpha is restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: native RGBA to RGB (expose zero-alpha native RGB); full canvas nearest8x, no crop/rotation

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt argument preserves original CRLF and equals UTF-8 prompt file bytes without trailing newline.
reference_argument_serialization: Actual reference tool arguments were absolute paths resolved against current repository root; metadata retains exact image identities via portable repo-relative paths with byte SHA256.
